Class MKHudIcon

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.hud.MKHudIcon
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class MKHudIcon extends Object implements PanelElement
HUD sprite icon element — renders a texture sprite at configurable size.

Uses vanilla's graphics.blitSprite() for rendering, which reads from the GUI texture atlas.

Implements PanelElement. Phase 8 will subsume this into the core Icon element.

Part of the MenuKit framework.
